q_norm: each holding list see share table these where
question: give me a table where I can see the list of these holding of each share
sql:
WITH customer_holdings AS (
    SELECT 
        t.ISIN,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(t.TRANSACTIONTYPE) = 'BUY' THEN t.UNITS ELSE -t.UNITS END) AS net_units,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(t.TRANSACTIONTYPE) = 'BUY' THEN t.TOTALVALUE ELSE -t.TOTALVALUE END) AS net_value
    FROM FAR_TRANS.TRANSACTIONS AS t
    WHERE t.CUSTOMERID = 'DD35198E5AFDB753ED0D'
    GROUP BY t.ISIN
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(t.TRANSACTIONTYPE) = 'BUY' THEN t.UNITS ELSE -t.UNITS END) > 0
),
total_portfolio AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_value) AS total_value
    FROM customer_holdings
)
SELECT 
    ch.ISIN AS "Holding (ISIN)",
    ROUND(ch.net_value, 2) AS "Value",
    ROUND((ch.net_value / tp.total_value) * 100, 2) AS "Portfolio Share (%)"
FROM customer_holdings ch
CROSS JOIN total_portfolio tp
ORDER BY ch.net_value DESC
